name: Knott's Sutter's Funnel Cake & Boysenberry Topping (Deep-Fried & Berry Seed Warning)
brandOrRestaurant: Sutter's Funnel Cake & Cable Car Kitchen (Knott's Berry Farm)
whyItWorks: Reference warning: funnel cake batter is poured directly into hot fryer oil (creating massive surface area that sponges up oil) and topped with whole seeded boysenberries, dairy soft-serve, and sugar.
prepOrOrderInstructions: If your group orders a Funnel Cake, tear off just 1–2 small bites of plain powdered-sugar pastry that haven't touched the seeded boysenberry compote.
watchOuts: Very high fryer oil absorption + insoluble boysenberry seeds + dairy lactose
